Sync & Connection

100 = original desktop size. 120 = 20% larger.
Syncs automatically on startup. Use global Push/Pull to force. Use “Push Planner + Settings” only when you intend to update settings on the server (admin only). Auto Pull/Push run when set & you’re logged in (Push requires manager/admin). Imports and cache reset now create a local safety backup that can be restored from this panel.

Idle full screen display

Idle full-screen is off.
The timer only runs while this app is visible, focused, logged in, and receiving no keyboard, touch, mouse, wheel, or scroll input. Automatic browser-native full screen may still be limited by some browsers, but the app-only full screen display will still open.

Request pop-ups

Pop-ups are triggered after Pull/Auto Pull updates (manager/admin only). The Requests badge still updates regardless.
Notifications
Uses your browser’s notification permission.
Email notifications (EmailJS)
Requires EmailJS account + template (see template notes in Settings).
Suggested EmailJS template params: to_email, subject, message, pending_count, workspace.
